analysis.headline: March costs rose alongside a sustained baseline increase
analysis.explanation: The bill was {{bill_total}}, up {{bill_change}}. Daily usage changed {{daily_change}} across {{feb_days}} February days and {{march_days}} March days. Usage rose after {{signal_start}}: nighttime demand increased from {{baseline_night}} to {{march_night}}, with a {{baseline_step}} baseline step and a minimum draw of {{minimum_draw}}. This suggests sustained extra demand, but its cause is unconfirmed. Weather leaves {{weather_residual}} unexplained; the fit is weak and March is outside its training range, so weather is not established as the cause. Usage was above the {{peer_count}} matched homes' average of {{peer_kwh}}; peer matching has limitations.
